blocks.raw: # Create LINE Template
blocks.text: Create LINE Template

blocks.raw: # Introduction
blocks.text: Introduction

blocks.raw: A template is user-defined content that can be created once and reused whenever required for that channel. Line channel supports templates for Card messages and Rich messages.
blocks.text: A template is user-defined content that can be created once and reused whenever required for that channel. Line channel supports templates for Card messages and Rich messages.

blocks.raw: ## Card message template
blocks.text: Card message template

blocks.raw: A Card message is a combination of text, image, and action (Call to action or CTA). You can add up to 10 images in a single message. Each message can have a redirection URL or text reply action (in a carousel format).
blocks.text: A Card message is a combination of text, image, and action (Call to action or CTA). You can add up to 10 images in a single message. Each message can have a redirection URL or text reply action (in a carousel format).

blocks.raw: ## Prerequisites
blocks.text: Prerequisites

blocks.raw: Before starting with creating a Card message, you need to have the image(s) available in your local system with the following properties.
blocks.text: Before starting with creating a Card message, you need to have the image(s) available in your local system with the following properties.

blocks.raw:
* Image dimension: 1024 x 1024 pixels
* Image size should not exceed 1 MB per file
* Image format: JPEG or PNG
blocks.text: Image dimension: 1024 x 1024 pixelsImage size should not exceed 1 MB per fileImage format: JPEG or PNG

blocks.raw: ### Create Text message template
blocks.text: Create Text message template

blocks.raw:
1. In the Template name, enter a name for the template.
2. In-**Text message**, add your message. To include dynamic tags inline the message, click **+ Add labels** and click on the tags that you want to include in the message.
3. You can see the message preview in the mobile widget.
4. When completed, click **Done** to save the template.

blocks.text: Create Image template

2. Click **Your computer** to upload an image from your local system. Alternatively, you can also drag and drop the image from your local system to the image area.

blocks.raw: ### Create Rich message template
blocks.text: Create Rich message template

blocks.raw: A Rich message is an image with multiple clickable areas that you can use to redirect recipients to different pages.
blocks.text: A Rich message is an image with multiple clickable areas that you can use to redirect recipients to different pages.

blocks.raw: There are two types of layouts for a Rich Message.
blocks.text: There are two types of layouts for a Rich Message.

blocks.raw:
* **Square**:  An image of size 1040 × 1040 with multiple clickable grid areas.
* **Custom**: An image of size ranging from 1040 × (520 to 2080) with a single clickable area.
blocks.text: Square:  An image of size 1040 × 1040 with multiple clickable grid areas.Custom: An image of size ranging from 1040 × (520 to 2080) with a single clickable area.

blocks.raw: #### To create a rich message template, follow these steps.
blocks.text: To create a rich message template, follow these steps.

blocks.raw:
1. In the Template name, enter a name for the template.
2. Click **Select Template** and select your preferred layout for the message.
blocks.text: In the Template name, enter a name for the template.Click Select Template and select your preferred layout for the message.

blocks.raw:
* **Square** You can have an image of standard size 1040 × 1040 with multiple clickable grid areas.
* **Custom**: You can have an image with a size ranging from 1040 × (520 to 2080) with a single clickable area.
blocks.text: Square You can have an image of standard size 1040 × 1040 with multiple clickable grid areas.Custom: You can have an image with a size ranging from 1040 × (520 to 2080) with a single clickable area.

blocks.raw:
3. Enter a **Title** for the message. The title should not exceed 100 characters.
4. Click **Your computer** to upload an image from your local system. Alternatively, you can also drag and drop the image from your local system to the image area. Make sure the image dimension is 1040px x 1040px and less than 10 MB.\
   **Note**: To change a selected image, click **Reupload**.
5. In the **Enter URL** Link box, type the URL of the page that must be redirected when the user clicks the image.\
   When you select a template that has multiple partitions, then you will see URL options for each partition. For example, if there are three partitions in a template, you will see three separate fields for URL.
   You can see the message preview on the right pane.
6. Click **Done** to save the changes.

blocks.raw: ### Create Card message template
blocks.text: Create Card message template

blocks.raw:
1. In the Template name, enter a name for the template.
2. Enter a **Title** for the message. The title should not exceed 100 characters.
3. Upload an image in the Upload Image area using any of the following processes.
blocks.text: In the Template name, enter a name for the template.Enter a Title for the message. The title should not exceed 100 characters.Upload an image in the Upload Image area using any of the following processes.

blocks.raw:
* Click **Your computer** to upload from your local system. \[or]
* Click **Gallery** to upload an image from the library.\
  **Note**: To change a selected image, click **Reupload**.
blocks.text: Click Your computer to upload from your local system. [or]Click Gallery to upload an image from the library.Note: To change a selected image, click Reupload.

blocks.raw:
4. In **Action**, enter your preferred label name for the CTA option. Action name should not exceed 12 characters.
5. Select your preferred **Action Type**.
blocks.text: In Action, enter your preferred label name for the CTA option. Action name should not exceed 12 characters.Select your preferred Action Type.

blocks.raw:
* **Text**: To send an automated message to the brand's Line account from the recipients' account.
* **URL**: To redirect recipients to a specific URL.
blocks.text: Text: To send an automated message to the brand's Line account from the recipients' account.URL: To redirect recipients to a specific URL.

blocks.raw:
6. To add more cards to the message, click **+ Add card** and configure each card as explained in steps 1-4. You can add up to 10 images in a single message.
7. Click **Done** to save the message.
